assessment: This study presents valuable findings on the isolation of an antibody that recognizes a novel, highly conserved SARS-CoV-2 Spike (S) epitope, adding to the growing repertoire of anti-S antibodies cross-reactive against human and zoonotic coronaviruses. The authors provide solid evidence supporting their claims, although the proposed antiviral mechanism of the newly described antibody requires further validation, and in vivo effectiveness remains to be determined. The work will be of interest to biologists working to develop pan-coronavirus vaccines and therapies.
